column8: Default admission and the four source DML families are typed; sharding, table/index shape, worker execution, and result output remain outside this policy leaf.
Admission precedes worker-error paths; failpoint injection, ignore-error behavior, SQL rendering, and job aggregation remain external.
Autocommit/in-transaction, batch-DML, weak-consistency, and snapshot gates are covered; table references, read clauses, FK checks, and catalog mutation remain external.
Statement-family admission includes REPLACE's InsertStmt branch; source metrics and NTDML statement labels remain external.
Admission remains independent of the max-execution-time failpoint; timeout checks and the full batch worker path remain external.
